newsitem.title: USA: Ligand files for share offering.
newsitem.headline: Ligand files for share offering.

text.p: Ligand Pharmaceuticals Inc said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission concerning a public offering of up to 2.75 million shares of its common stock.
The offering, which is being managed by Bear Stearns, Robertson Stephens and Hambrecht & Quist, also includes an underwriters' overallotment option of up to 412,500 additional shares.

Ligand said it plans to use proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes including product research and development, preclinical testing and clinical trials, as well as the acquisition and licensing of products and complementary technologies.
